record.bible_text: And the LORD<WH03068> spake<WH01696><WTH8762> unto Moses<WH04872>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>,

And if ye go<WH0935><WTH8799> to war<WH04421> in your land<WH0776> against<WH06862> the enemy that oppresseth<WH06887><WTH8802> you, then ye shall blow an alarm<WH07321><WTH8689> with the trumpets<WH02689>; and ye shall be remembered<WH02142><WTH8738> before<WH06440> the LORD<WH03068> your God<WH0430>, and ye shall be saved<WH03467><WTH8738> from your enemies<WH0341><WTH8802>.

Also in the day<WH03117> of your gladness<WH08057>, and in your solemn days<WH04150>, and in the beginnings<WH07218> of your months<WH02320>, ye shall blow<WH08628><WTH8804> with the trumpets<WH02689> over your burnt offerings<WH05930>, and over the sacrifices<WH02077> of your peace offerings<WH08002>; that they may be to you for a memorial<WH02146> before<WH06440> your God<WH0430>: I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068> your God<WH0430>.<CM>
